_comment: Survey crosstabs on support for the 2021 expanded Child Tax Credit. Every support_pct and sample_size in this file was read directly out of the source PDF listed in `url` and independently re-derived from the published cell percentages (support = strongly + somewhat). The placeholder record ev_001 that shipped in the STEP 0 stub has been REMOVED: it was invented data, and an invented row in a provenance file is worse than an empty file. Records with holdout=true are reserved for the A6 backtest and are excluded from poststratification.
_support_definition: support_pct = strongly support/approve + somewhat support/approve, as a fraction of that subgroup's unweighted N.
_known_limitation: No academic, peer-reviewed, or official-government source publishes public SUPPORT crosstabs for the 2021 CTC. Government and university work (Census, NBER, Columbia CPSP, Urban Institute) measures poverty, receipt, hardship and spending, not opinion. The usable support crosstabs come from nonpartisan commercial polling. This is stated in warnings rather than papered over.
_evidence_summary: 95 records. policy_key partitions them: a CTC estimate never pools in stimulus, UBI or whole-package polling. wording_group separates instrument effects from real change. holdout_group 'dec2021' is the clean out-of-sample test.
